description: SignalR **live job dashboard** for the Lyo job stack. `JobEventBroadcaster` subscribes to lifecycle and alert routing keys on the `job.events` exchange and pushes **`JobHubEvent`** records to all connected **`JobHub`** clients — enabling Blazor or JavaScript dashboards to refresh without polling.

examples.title: Register services
Client usage

sections.title: Client usage
sections.text: Connect to the hub and listen for **`JobEvent`**: `JobHub.Ping()` returns `"pong"` for connectivity checks.

sections.title: Broadcast events
sections.trail:
`JobHubEvent.WorkerType` is reserved for future filtering; the broadcaster currently passes `null`. Alert events carry the raw JSON alert body in `Message` when the routing-key
payload is not a run Guid.

sections.title: Architecture
sections.body:
```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph producers [Alert / lifecycle publishers]
        JS[JobService]
        SCH[JobScheduler]
        MAINT[JobMaintenanceService]
    end
    producers --> EX[job.events exchange]
    EX --> BC[JobEventBroadcaster]
    BC --> HUB[JobHub Clients.All]
    HUB --> UI[Blazor / JS dashboard]
    UI --> API[Job API CRUD for detail]
```

Pair with [`Lyo.Job.Web.Components`](../Lyo.Job.Web.Components/README.md) for the CRUD shell; use SignalR to invalidate or patch grids when events arrive.

sections.title: Configuration
sections.text: This package has no dedicated options type — it uses the host's SignalR and MQ configuration. Ensure CORS and WebSocket policies allow dashboard clients to reach the mapped hub path.

sections.title: Metrics
sections.text: The broadcaster does not emit dedicated metrics. Monitor underlying job metrics (`job.service.*`, `job.scheduler.*`, `job.sla.breach`) and MQ health via `IMqService` / `IHealth`.
